config.world: Point clouds of N points in d dimensions read through observers C = diag(i^-alpha) R, R a Haar-random rotation, G = I, budget B a quantization of the observed coordinates at a declared multiple of the observed median nearest-neighbour distance (B = 0 for the law). Training and held-out families are Gaussian with covariance eigenvalues i^-alpha_data. Unseen families, real corpora and scale cells run on the run seed only, against the law frozen at the pilot.
config.bars: PREREG-D2.md Section 5; the law and its nominal-dimension competitor frozen from the pilot into law.json; tolerances are declared multiples of the pilot's held-out error
